performance.scope: 10 seconds of one isolated coastal camp; no framebuffer readback/portrait HUD during measurement; not a whole-game or long-session guarantee

assets.bossArt: Direct user GIF/WebP, no generated pixels substituted
assets.generationTool: built-in image_gen for new art kept separately

unchanged: native player damage and timing logic
limits: Source Boss art is side-view; UP/DOWN reuse side-view and LEFT uses mirroring.
No source death clip: original idle fades.
Bow holds a forward pose; no bespoke two-hand draw cycle.
Five resident appearance families are shared by more than five named residents.
Boss checks use native target fixtures, not a physical-input full-fight balance or cross-process Boss reload claim.
